description: Auto-format code after each Edit tool use

hooks.command:
# Adapt the formatter command to your project (payload is JSON on stdin):
FILEPATH=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty')
# JavaScript/TypeScript: npx prettier --write "$FILEPATH"
# Python: black "$FILEPATH"
# PHP: php-cs-fixer fix "$FILEPATH"
# Go: gofmt -w "$FILEPATH"
# Rust: rustfmt "$FILEPATH"
echo 'Configure your formatter in this hook'

usage: Copy this template to .claude/settings.json and adapt the formatter command to your project's toolchain.
